title: Madhu Malati
desc: Malati, a rich landowner's daughter, and Debi, a simpleton, fall for Madhu, a popular man. However, he sees Debi as his friend and falls for Malati whose father has her betrothed to Rajesh, a thug.

title: Mejo Bou
desc: Barun's father forces him to marry Sampa, a colleague from a middle-class background. After the marriage, Barun creates problems for his new wife and damages her reputation.

title: Sangharsha
desc: In a village divided by corruption and power struggles between a politician and a doctor, honest newcomer Shubhankar challenges the status quo.

title: Geet Sangeet
desc: Abandoning his affluent background, a man chases his musical dreams. However, he finds himself employed as a driver and becomes smitten with his boss's daughter.

title: Pita
desc: An honest motor mechanic lives happily with his wife, two sons and an adopted son. Unfortunate incidents ensue when one of his sons falls in love with a rich girl and decides to marry her.

desc: Rishi is an aspiring film director who dreams of becoming successful in the world of cinema. However, his life changes when he teams up with Gumnaam Kapoor, a producer of erotic movies.

title: Hanshi Khushi Club
desc: Aniket, a middle-aged man, gets caught up in a strange situation when a young woman sneaks into his house. He later learns that the woman is a victim of domestic violence.

title: Rahul
desc: Caught in the emotional crossfire between his divorced parents, an innocent 5-year-old becomes collateral damage, and inevitably, this takes a toll on his health.

title: Patanjali Yog - By Yogrishi Swami Ramdev
desc: Baba Ramdev emphasises the importance of yoga and demonstrates various asanas and breathing exercises that enable one to lead a healthy and stress-free life.

title: Mahapurush O Kapurush
desc: Two scammers, Swami Sadgajananda and Pada, make their living by fooling the public. While one claims to be an incarnation of God to draw followers, the other exploits the chaos to rob people's houses.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.
